claim: The one-click sample is isolated from real history, does not duplicate on reload, resets, and is deleted on exit.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a real-history marker; enter Demo, reload twice, reset, exit, and inspect both IndexedDB namespaces

claim: Identical photo bytes match even when filenames differ.
sandbox: seeded Demo has renamed identical media; assert the exact-match outcome

claim: An incomplete still-plus-MOV Live Photo pair is reported.
sandbox: seeded Demo omits one matched still; assert both pair members show incomplete evidence

claim: The complete free check works without an account.
sandbox: fresh browser context with no credentials; complete the seeded check and assert there is no sign-in gate

claim: The checker reads the first and last 64 KiB of a deterministic 10% sample of matched files.
where: checker, method section, privacy page, README
sandbox: 20 matched in-memory 70,000-byte files; instrument Blob slices; assert two stable selections and both edge reads for each

claim: CSV export contains one row per source asset.
sandbox: seeded Demo; download CSV and assert its header plus four source rows

claim: JSON export contains the current report in photo-backup-sentinel/v1 format.
sandbox: seeded Demo; download JSON and inspect its format and report count

claim: A Sentinel JSON export can be imported into real check history.
sandbox: export the Demo report, open the real namespace, import it, and open the restored result

claim: After one online visit, routes, local scanning, and saved checks work offline.
where: first-screen fact, offline notice, terms, README
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; activate worker, go offline, reload Demo, run a fixture scan, reload history, then open legal and 404 routes

claim: Sample and real checks make no cross-origin or write request and set no cookie.
sandbox: fresh Demo followed by a fixture folder check; record every request and cookie through both completed results

claim: Saved checks contain report metadata but no media bytes, EXIF fields, location fields, or retained folder access.
sandbox: run a fixture check; inspect the IndexedDB object graph for expected fields and forbidden binary/metadata values; reload and inspect folder selection

claim: A check does not change or copy selected files.
sandbox: hash, stat, and list both fixture folders before and after the browser check; assert exact equality

claim: The free edition keeps the latest three checks locally.
where: history and Pro sections, privacy page, README
sandbox: run four checks after the seeded Demo record and assert only three remain

claim: Local check history remains after refresh.
sandbox: run fixture checks, reload, and assert the same three records remain

claim: A valid Pro license raises local history to 30 checks.
where: Pro section, privacy page, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser with a valid cached verdict; import 31 reports and assert 30 visible and stored records

claim: A checkout-return license or pasted license is stored and verified through the Sociobot endpoint.
sandbox: mock Sociobot verification; exercise callback capture, URL cleanup, pasted restore, stored token, and active Pro status

claim: After a license response, the app waits at least 24 hours before verifying again.
sandbox: seed a stale cached verdict, count Sociobot verification requests across two reloads, and assert only the first reload sends one

claim: Sentinel Pro costs $19 once and opens the Sociobot hosted checkout.
where: first-screen fact, Pro section, terms, README
sandbox: assert the exact legal offer, follow Buy Sentinel Pro, and observe navigation to the product's Sociobot checkout URL
